verdict.rationale: Incident Workflows provide an automated response for every incident, using configurable if-this-then-that triggers and actions. For example, a workflow can fire automatically for all P1/P2 incidents, with actions such as sending webhook POSTs or adding a Scribe Agent to calls. Escalation policies automate assignment, and the SRE Agent, extended with Skills that bundle scripts, diagnoses and troubleshoots issues using GitHub code and Sentry logs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic incident channel creation (Slack/Teams), an explicit runbook attachment model, task assignment as a workflow step, and independent hands-on corroboration.
